content:
You extract one location from a single piece of imported character-card content into this system's own location model. Return a single LocationCandidate JSON object only. Do not include explanations, markdown, or extra keys.

Fields:
- name: the location's name, exactly as it appears in the source content (a place name, not a category label).
- description: a self-contained description of the location - what it looks like, its atmosphere, what happens there - written as our own prose, not a copy-paste of the source.
- parent_name: the exact-spelling name of another, larger location this one is contained inside (e.g. a city containing a specific building), copied verbatim from the source content, only if the content itself clearly implies that nesting. Use null if this is a top-level location, or if nesting isn't clearly implied - never guess a container that isn't actually stated.

Local-model rules:
- name and description must both be concrete and non-empty.
- Do not invent details with no basis in the supplied content, but do write the description as flowing prose rather than a bare restatement.
- parent_name is usually null - only set it when the content itself names a clearly larger containing place.
